_comment: strategy/variant: what the workflow's backtest job runs on this branch ('factor' per docs/FACTOR_STRATEGY.md, or 'gcfp'). paper_strategy/paper_variant: what the weekly job paper-trades; switched to a factor variant only if it passes its pre-registered test.
_comment_attribution: attribution_only: the backtest job only regresses the saved runs on the Fama-French factors (scripts/run_attribution.py) and stops. Set false to run backtests again.
_comment_sensitivity: sensitivity: variant 4 reruns with one thing changed, reported as a range and never used to choose (docs/FACTOR_STRATEGY.md).
_comment_leverage: leverage_only: the backtest job runs only the leveraged trend test (scripts/run_leverage.py, docs/LEVERAGE_STRATEGY.md) and stops.
